messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: [SEV2] Tenant Gamma: sudden quality regression on gen API after quant profile update, high error rate reported by customer. Paging oncall.
anna_oncall: Ack. Pulling logs and traffic. Assigning SRE + ML.
anna_oncall: @maya_sre you oncall? can you grab the routing/host info for tenant-gamma dedicated pool?
maya_sre: I'm here. Getting pool ids and recent deploys.
maya_sre: Found a config rollout 03:18 UTC that updated quantization profile for model: gpt-redwood-gamma-v2 -> int8-mix.
raj_ml: I'm on it. Loading evals vs pre-rollout baseline.
ops_tenant_gamma: Customer Ops (tenant-gamma) reporting: "SLA-sensitive scoring pipeline returning lower-quality completions, lots of truncation and factual errors". They provided examples.
jordan_csm: Notifying customer success and AE. Lee, can you prepare a customer-facing note?
lee_acctexec: On it — will coordinate after we confirm mitigation.
raj_ml: Quick sanity check: running prompt samples against current model variant and previous model.
raj_ml: sample-before: "Revenue grew 12% year-over-year."
raj_ml: sample-after (int8-mix): "Revenue grew 120% year over year!!!" -> clear numeric hallucination, confidence scores low.
anna_oncall: Correlating with traffic metrics now — error rate on inference quality tests spiked at 03:20 UTC matching rollout.
maya_sre: Pool isolation confirmed: tenant-gamma in dedicated pool gp-ded-4, only they were targeted by rollout. So tenant isolation preserved, no cross-tenant impact.
sam_platform: Could be quant profile aggressiveness for long sequences. Check KV-cache handling.
raj_ml: Looking at softmax temperature/scale changes after quantization: observed distribution shift. Repro on local with int8-mix.
raj_ml: Immediate mitigation options: 1) Revert quant profile for tenant-gamma only back to previous (fp16 or int8-conservative) 2) Pin tenant to model variant v2-fp16 (no quant) 3) Rollback the rollout (if staged)
anna_oncall: Which is fastest with lowest risk?
sam_platform: Reverting tenant-specific quant profile is fastest — config change in control plane, no model binary swap. I can issue rollback for tenant-gamma now.
deploy-bot: deploy:run rollback --tenant tenant-gamma --config quant_profile --to int8-conservative queued by sam_platform
sam_platform: Executing now. ETA ~2 min.
maya_sre: I'll monitor latency and error rate during revert.
raj_ml: Also starting a short canary: re-evaluate sample prompts after revert.
ops_tenant_gamma: We'll tell customer Ops that action is in progress. Ask them to hold client traffic if they prefer.
lee_acctexec: Drafting message: "We've identified a quantization profile change affecting your model. We're reverting to the prior profile now; we'll follow up with timeline and permanent fix."
anna_oncall: Revert acknowledged by control plane.
deploy-bot: deploy:success rollback --tenant tenant-gamma --config quant_profile --to int8-conservative completed in 38s
raj_ml: Running post-revert checks...
raj_ml: sample-after-revert: "Revenue grew 12% year-over-year." -> matches baseline. Quality metrics (BLEU/ROUGE / custom scoring) back within tolerance.
maya_sre: Latency unchanged. Error/quality alerts cleared. No cross-tenant impact.
ops_tenant_gamma: Customer confirmed they see improved outputs in staging.
jordan_csm: Sending customer update now.
lee_acctexec: Message sent. Customer appreciated rapid response; asked for RCA and preventative steps.
anna_oncall: Next steps: - raj_ml to do root cause on int8-mix config sensitivity and create conservative profile - sam_platform to add canary gating for quant profile changes on dedicated pools - maya_sre to run isolation test playbook - create postmortem and notify product/rls.
raj_ml: I'll open ticket with regression reproducer, attach samples and perf deltas. Plan: tighten quantization thresholds and add unit evals covering tenant long-sequence prompts.
sam_platform: I'll add an automatic holdout canary for any quant config rollout that targets dedicated pools: doc + infra change.
maya_sre: I'll add post-incident runbook steps and schedule a DR drill for tenant isolation scenarios.
anna_oncall: Assigning owners: raj_ml (RCA), sam_platform (infra fix), maya_sre (playbook), jordan_csm (customer follow-up).
anna_oncall: Closing pager. Please update ticket with all artifacts. :white_check_mark:
ops_tenant_gamma: Thanks team. Will follow up if customer sees any other issues.
incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED: Sev2 -> mitigated. Timeline recorded.
